name: summervgame.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: summervgame.com scores 63 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 25 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 200. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Next.js 15.5.7 has known flaws
fix.evidence: Next.js 15.5.7 (read from the page): 32 known flaws, the worst rated critical, such as GHSA-mwv6-3258-q52c, GHSA-w37m-7fhw-fmv9, CVE-2025-59471. Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when AVIF files are used. Checked…

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /search. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The TLS certificate is valid for 84 more days
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 143 ms
Every page has a meta description
